description: This file contains client-side scripts for managing 'Stock Entry' documents in ERPNext, including setup, validation, UI interactions, and related operations for stock management workflows.

classes.name: erpnext.stock.StockEntry
classes.description: Class representing the Stock Entry document, extending StockController, with methods for setup, validation, and operations related to stock management.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the form, sets query filters, fetches default settings, and attaches BOM items.

methods.name: setup_quality_inspection
methods.description: Configures quality inspection options and related query filters.

methods.name: outgoing_stock_entry
methods.description: Sets items for stock in when outgoing stock entry is triggered.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, toggles UI elements, and adds relevant buttons based on document status.

methods.name: scan_barcode
methods.description: Initiates barcode scanning for stock items.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Performs cleanup after form submission.

methods.name: after_cancel
methods.description: Performs cleanup after canceling the document.

methods.name: set_default_account
methods.description: Sets default expense account based on company settings.

methods.name: clean_up
methods.description: Removes work order from locals if applicable.

methods.name: fg_completed_qty
methods.description: Fetches items based on finished goods quantity.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Retrieves stock items based on BOM and manufacturing quantity.

methods.name: work_order
methods.description: Fetches work order details and updates related fields.

methods.name: toggle_enable_bom
methods.description: Enables or disables BOM field based on work order presence.

methods.name: add_excise_button
methods.description: Adds an Excise Invoice button for India.

methods.name: items_add
methods.description: Copies expense account and cost center to new items.

methods.name: from_warehouse
methods.description: Sets warehouse in child items when source warehouse changes.

methods.name: to_warehouse
methods.description: Sets warehouse in child items when target warehouse changes.

methods.name: set_warehouse_in_children
methods.description: Autofills warehouse in child table rows.

methods.name: items_on_form_rendered
methods.description: Initial setup when form is rendered.

methods.name: toggle_related_fields
methods.description: Enables/disables fields based on purpose.

methods.name: supplier
methods.description: Fetches supplier details.
